- **Purpose:** Explore task scores 
   - summary of score per task
   - distribution of score per task
   - tasks with very low scores
   - tasks with little to no variation
   - correlation between tasks
- **Input:** wide score df
- **Output:** none

```{r}
library(GGally)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
load("data/processed/scores_long.RData")
```

# join task numbers and names

```{r}
tasklist <- read.xlsx('data/SWAP_input/tasklist_test_gtex.xlsx')

tasklist_names <- tasklist %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c('ID', 'DESCRIPTION', 'SHOULD.FAIL')) %>%
  mutate(ID = paste('task', ID, sep = '_'))
```

```{r}
df_results_scores <- df_results_scores %>%
  left_join(tasklist_names, join_by('task' == 'ID')) %>%
  mutate(task_name = paste0(task, ': ', DESCRIPTION))
```

# distribution of scores per task
```{r}
ggplot(df_results_scores, aes(score, fill = task))+
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)+
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df_results_scores, aes(y= score, x = fct_reorder(task_name, score)))+
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2))+
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0)+
  theme_minimal()+
  coord_flip()
```

# summary per task

```{r}
summary_per_task <- df_results_scores %>%
  group_by(task) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score, na.rm = T),
            median = median(score, na.rm = T),
            sd = sd(score, na.rm = T),
            CV = sd/mean * 100)
```

tasks with very low scores
```{r}
summary_per_task %>%
  filter(median <= 1)
# not the case here but some tasks can be as low as median = 0.0001
```

tasks with no variation or very low variation
```{r}
summary_per_task %>%
  filter(sd == 0)
# not the case here, but some tasks use only 1 reaction, and if that reaction is driven by an inactive gene the variation can be null

summary_per_task %>%
  filter(sd < 1)

summary_per_task %>%
  filter(CV < 1)
```

# correlation between tasks
```{r}
# plot (not a good idea for >10 tasks)
df_results_scores %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, task, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = task, values_from = score) %>%
  ggpairs(lower = list(continuous = wrap('points', alpha = 0.4)),
          upper = list(continuous = wrap('cor', method = 'spearman')))+
  theme_bw()

# cor matrix
cor_matrix <- df_results_scores %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, task, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = task, values_from = score) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample) %>%
  cor(., use = 'pairwise.complete.obs', method = 'spearman')

pheatmap(cor_matrix,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),   # centres white at 0
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 6)
```
